The '''Durs Ranch''' was a leisure [[Farm/Legends|ranch]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Froswythe]] that was operated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jerren Durs]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a group of individuals stayed at the ranch while on a vacation and early one morning, Jerren Durs and his guests rode out from the ranch on [[ycaqt]]s, to round up a herd of [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].
